title: Air Station Elizabeth City saves man and his dog 'Lucky' from roof
description:
Coast Guard aircrews from Air Station Elizabeth City, North Carolina, rescue a man and his dog 'lucky' off a rooftop after Hurricane Florence, north of the Cape Fear River, North Carolina, Sept. 17, 2018. The man and the dog were initially in the van when the flooding began, but were able to get on the top of the van and eventually the roof of a building before being rescued.
(U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Elizabeth City)
